class.name: SlsaProvenance
class.description: Generates and signs SLSA v1.0 provenance for a finished build's artifacts, server-side, and publishes it as the provenance.intoto.jsonl artifact.

param.name: slsa.signer
param.description: Where the signing key lives and, for AWS KMS, how the server obtains credentials.

param.name: slsa.server.privateKeyPath
param.description: Absolute path, on the server, to an EC or RSA PEM private key (PKCS#8, PKCS#1, or SEC1).

param.name: slsa.aws.region
param.description: Region of the KMS key (e.g. us-east-1). Optional for the default provider chain.

param.name: slsa.kms.keyId
param.description: Asymmetric SIGN_VERIFY KMS key: id, alias, or ARN.

param.name: slsa.kms.signingAlgorithm
param.description: KMS signing algorithm matching the key spec (e.g. ECDSA_SHA_256).

param.name: slsa.aws.region
param.description: Region of the KMS key (e.g. us-east-1).

param.name: slsa.kms.keyId
param.description: Asymmetric SIGN_VERIFY KMS key: id, alias, or ARN.

param.name: slsa.kms.signingAlgorithm
param.description: KMS signing algorithm matching the key spec (e.g. ECDSA_SHA_256).

param.name: secure:slsa.aws.secretAccessKey
param.description: AWS secret access key. Stored encrypted.

param.name: slsa.aws.region
param.description: Region of the KMS key (e.g. us-east-1).

param.name: slsa.kms.keyId
param.description: Asymmetric SIGN_VERIFY KMS key: id, alias, or ARN.

param.name: slsa.kms.signingAlgorithm
param.description: KMS signing algorithm matching the key spec (e.g. ECDSA_SHA_256).

param.name: slsa.aws.assumeRole.arn
param.description: IAM role to assume (scoped to kms:Sign) before signing.

param.name: slsa.aws.assumeRole.sessionName
param.description: Assumed-role session name. Defaults to teamcity-slsa-signer.

param.name: slsa.aws.assumeRole.externalId
param.description: External id required by some cross-account role trust policies.

param.name: slsa.aws.assumeRole.durationSeconds
param.description: Lifetime of the temporary credentials, in seconds.

param.name: slsa.failBuildOnError
param.description: Fail the build when provenance cannot be produced. Off by default (a failure only logs a warning).

example.description: Sign provenance with an AWS KMS key, using the server's default credentials provider chain.
Sign provenance with an AWS KMS key by assuming a dedicated kms:Sign-scoped IAM role, and fail the build if provenance cannot be produced.
Sign provenance with a PEM private key stored on the TeamCity server.
